mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and clear out at Badger Prairie County Park, with a lovely waxing crescent moon phase currently visible.

The Verona Senior Center is currently accepting volunteer applications for those interested in supporting local programs. Please note that some roles require light physical activity, and all volunteers must agree to strict confidentiality standards regarding participant information.
There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at several local venues throughout the weekend, and the unique Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds tomorrow.
On August 5, Verona police officers arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee the scene.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle. Please note that the store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10:00 AM.
